Former BJP MLA Killed by Villagers Over Stone Crusher Dispute

Former Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA Bhadana was killed by villagers in Bharatpur, Rajasthan, following a dispute over the restarting of a stone crusher. The incident occurred due to a disagreement related to mining activities.
